data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
specific_events: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels (30 December 2020)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m in 2021; Covid-19 was a material influence on 2020 results and subsequent reserve development.

prior_year_events.event_name: High frequency of natural catastrophe events
prior_year_events.impact_description: 2020 was heavily impacted by a high frequency of natural catastrophe events which materially worsened claims and reserves for that year.

The 2018 year of account closed externally into the 2021 year of account of another managing agent following a reinsurance to close agreement; adjusted opening technical provisions and affected comparatives.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels
prior_year_events.impact_description: Part VII transfer of EEA policies to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 December 2020 and immediate 100% quota share reinsurance back to the syndicate changed presentation of those premiums and related cash flows; transaction had no economic impact but affected reporting and balances.

In December 2021 the syndicate entered into an LPT with RiverStone covering majority of classes no longer written; premium ceded GBP 14m (of which GBP 4m will earn in future years) and the reinsurers' share of change in provisions includes recoveries due on business reinsured; net impact quoted as a 0.3% improvement on combined ratio.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate experienced Covid-19 related losses; 2021 saw a favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m.

named_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels
named_events.loss_description: Policies and related liabilities underwritten in the EEA were transferred to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 December 2020 and reinsured back to the syndicate; no economic impact for the syndicate but impacted presentation and cash flows.
Premium ceded GBP 14m under the LPT, of which GBP 4m will earn in future calendar years; net impact to the syndicate was a 0.3% improvement on the combined ratio.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 Syndicate 1861's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was GBP 770.971m. Analysis of the gross claims development shows an adverse re-estimate on the 2019 underwriting year of approximately GBP 34.5m (gross), representing a ~4.48% strengthening versus opening gross claims outstanding. Management attributes movements to a mix of factors including natural catastrophe-driven large loss development, some COVID-19 related movements (a favourable GBP 1.3m reported), reinsurance transactions (RITC adjustments and an LPT in December 2021) and recoveries; overall the prior-year movement is an adverse strengthening on the older years.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2021, Syndicate 1861 recorded a post LPT profit of GBP 2.6m (2020: GBP 175.8m loss) with a combined ratio of 98.6% and 98.9% pre LPT (2020: 134.5%).
The net loss ratio improved by 35.4% to 56.1% in 2021, with 2020 being heavily impacted by the unprecedented Covid-19 pandemic and a high frequency of natural catastrophe events.
Despite further Covid-19 enforced restrictions in 2021, the Syndicate has had favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m.
Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
At 31 December 2020 the 2018 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close agreement.

In December 2021 CMA entered into a Loss Portfolio Transfer Reinsurance (LPT) agreement with RiverStone Managing Agency Limited covering the majority of classes of business no longer written by Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years of account) and 1861 (2020 year of account only).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken directly from the 2020 comparative column of the Balance Sheet (explicit). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) by comparing the 2019 column current estimate to its previous diagonal (one-year prior) and excluding 2020 and 2021 per instructions. The report contains RITC and LPT transactions which required adjusted opening positions and may distort development comparatives; narrative also provides net prior-year movements (e.g. net deterioration GBP 0.8m) but a gross triangle was available and used. Some causal figures quoted in the report are net of reinsurance; where only net numbers exist they have not been used as primary sources. Lob-level prior-year movements are not explicitly provided, so lob_movements is left empty.
